title: Sunday · the cannery
logline: The cannery on the bay: rust, gulls, the chimney. Six selected of fifty; this is the rust one.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the cannery from across the water, corrugated tin gone to rust in long streaks, the chimney, gulls on the roofline.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, an abandoned cannery across bay water with corrugated tin streaked in rust, a tall chimney and gulls along the roofline, no words

panels.name: Rust

panels.composition: Tier 2: one panel of tin, close, the rust in the watercolor's own bloom.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, close on a sheet of corrugated tin with rust blooming across it in watercolor, no words

panels.name: Tin

panels.composition: Tier 3: the chimney against the sky. A gull. Held.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor, muddy early-digital scan, a tall brick chimney against a pale sky with one gull, no words

panels.name: Chimney
